headline: Wilmington and Felician yet to lose in conference play
dek: Neither Wilmington nor Felician has lost since conference play opened. Wilmington's three defeats all came before it, and the win over Post takes a season that now stands at nine wins and five draws; Felician last won at Bridgeport.
displaced_by: truth: the standing dek's Wilmington last outing (at Chestnut Hill) and eight-win figure no longer hold after the win over Post; the headline still holds and stands

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Goals have not decided the table: Bridgeport have scored 38 and conceded 35, in a season of six wins, three draws and seven defeats.

wire.line: Felician's Mathias Kristoffersen has kept seven shutouts and conceded ten goals all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Gijs van Eif has scored eight goals for Georgian Court and assisted eight more, from 60 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dane Bodziak has scored eight goals for Chestnut Hill from 16 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Goldey-Beacom have conceded 49 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, in a season of one win, three draws and twelve defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bruno Mestres has made 96 saves for Holy Family and conceded 21 goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Eliass Elfasoukhi has scored seven of Post's goals from 30 shots, with three assists beside them.

last_match.line: Wilmington have won every match they have played in October, at home and away.

next_match.line: Goldey-Beacom are still without a conference win; Felician have not lost at home in conference play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
